description:
Functional specifications/files: inspect lib/zaq/people/{resolver,identity_resolver}.ex, lib/zaq/accounts/{people,person_identities}.ex, lib/zaq/channels/{identity_scope,api}.ex and jido_chat_bridge.ex. Define authoritative identity versus enrichment, field provenance/replacement eligibility, refresh policy, missing/error behavior and compatibility for every direct discovery caller (Engine conversations/history, ingestion permissions, audience resolution). Keep stable public signatures where possible. Determine whether existing Jido UserInfo metadata suffices; do not prematurely extend upstream schemas.
Tests to add before implementation: contract examples and bounded properties for trusted evidence validation, default safety and preservation of explicit profile edits; cover at least two providers and connector-scoped versus shared authority.
Branches/paths validated: known/unknown identity, enrichment-only phone, authoritative conflicts, absent/malformed evidence, unsupported/failed enrichment, delayed values. Nil identity never grants privileges; untrusted incoming metadata cannot select ownership or replacement policy.
Documentations: describe the resulting contract at its existing service/architecture owner and module docs; read docs/documentation.md before editing. Escalate any architecture change outside the established contract before implementation.
Action reuse assessment: extend existing discovery/profile APIs, local-only canonical value contract. No new standalone business operation or tool; avoid an Action wrapping pure mapping. Inputs trusted canonical identity/profile evidence; outputs validated canonical values or controlled errors, with no persistence in normalization. Existing code consumers and Channels event boundary remain; no tool/workflow exposure. Verification via contract tests and consumer inventory.
Policies: read AGENTS.md, docs/agent-tools.md, docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/testing-approach.md and applicable module/service guidance before implementation. For sibling changes read ../jido_chat_whatsapp/AGENTS.md. Follow the authoritative validation lifecycle; preserve existing assertions. No commits, pushes or merges are authorized by this plan.
Mocking plan: keep internal modules and database boundaries real; isolate external transport at its existing contract, with connection-scoped offline fixtures. Avoid global configuration mutation.
E2E: no new UI or user journey; unit, property and thin integration tests provide the required coverage. Reassess if scope changes.

Implementation constraint confirmed with user: add no new ZAQ modules. Extend existing module responsibilities and existing canonical maps/callbacks. Do not introduce a discovery policy module, profile evidence module, wrapper Action, or provider-specific helper under People. Keep the contract minimal and document it in existing owners. If implementation evidence makes this constraint impossible, explain the concrete conflict before changing the agreed scope.

Adapter alignment evidence: inspected installed deps/jido_chat_mattermost, jido_chat_telegram and jido_chat_discord. Mattermost Adapter.get_user/2 builds display_name from first/last name with username fallback and returns a map. Telegram incoming messages expose external_user_id, username and first-name display_name. Discord incoming messages expose external_user_id, username and global_name/username display_name. Telegram/Discord adapters do not implement get_user/2 in these versions. Shared Jido.Chat.Adapter accepts UserInfo or map and optional profile lookup. Preserve this existing canonical Incoming plus optional profile lookup pattern; do not require all adapters to implement a new evidence/provenance/refresh protocol. Any ZAQ ownership/replacement semantics must remain minimal internal rules and preserve these existing callers. Retain unsupported-profile fallback. Verify these three providers as compatibility cases.

comments.text: Implemented canonical discovery contract in existing modules: direct phone remains identity evidence; adapter profile phone is profile_phone enrichment. Native identity and email ownership remain authoritative. Generic name replacement covers generated channel-ID and canonical-email fallback. No new ZAQ module or Jido schema. Reviewed Mattermost, Telegram and Discord adapter shapes. No historical repair.

title: [zaq-10n.1] Define the canonical identity and profile evidence contract
